show_us.title: At Codenation Studio, we create technology aligned with your company's strategic objectives

purpose.title: We'll be with you throughout the entire journey
purpose.description:
Our purpose: to put innovation and digital technology at the service of the business objectives of startups and established companies.  

 How? By developing new products and services, optimizing operations and communications, and even partnering to launch new brands together.  

 We manage processes from concept to implementation and follow-up. And we even help you access financing to make your business idea a reality.

solutions.title: In love with technology
solutions.description:
Fascinated by its possibilities and results, but applying it with impartiality and judgment. 

 We design and develop the solutions necessary for business objectives. We embrace innovation without fear of complexity, but without seeking complexity. Technology, at its best. 

 • Analytics, big data, and business intelligence. 

 • Internet of Things. 

 • Artificial intelligence. 

 • Software, apps, systems, and web and mobile platforms development.

contact.title: We are the technological partner for major challenges
contact.description: At Codenation Studio, we put a lot of effort into selecting the projects we collaborate on. If you'd like us to assess your case to see if we can help you optimize with technology and grow with our business vision, you can contact us.

story.title: “Then it would be fun to accompany him.”
story.description: Athlete, skier, expert carpenter… and also daring, inventive, and loyal. Olav Bjäland was the partner Amundsen was looking for to conquer unexplored regions. And it all started with a chance meeting after winning an international ski championship.
